data.name: ReportScope
data.value: This public view shows aggregate fleet status, recorded A2S probe outcomes, and one explicitly advertised public connection endpoint. Missing buckets are unknown and excluded from the observed percentage. A2S history is not API uptime and does not activate or prove an SLO. The advertised game endpoint is configured separately from private inventory; provider identifiers, command history, credentials, and administrative data remain private.
